rule: ruling:sam-2026-10-07 claims 8 and 11: the prototype wins by default and only a DR1 judgement on the same difference or a real constraint the prototype cannot express overrides it; DR1 made no judgement here (row inc-150 deferred it), and the deleted-address constraint is still expressed by the card counting as unfinished with the specific error in its row, so the prototype's one-entry-per-unfinished-card summary (prototype-dr2-1-source-p11-043) wins.
outcome: The review's error summary follows Design Release 2.1: one entry per unfinished card, each linking to its card. A party whose saved address has been deleted makes the roles and addresses card unfinished, so the summary carries the single 'Complete roles and addresses' entry linking to #roles-and-addresses, and the specific deleted-address message ('Select an address for the consignor') stays on that party's row inside the card. The separate party entry is dropped. Because the card entry stays, a second unanswered role in the same card is never hidden (the concern DR1 row inc-150 raised). A test pins the full error list for a deleted consignor.
